home.description: Infrastructure that disappears — so people get their hours back. The governed control plane for taking AI agents into production: every task carries proven identity, executable authorization policy and a tamper-evident audit trail, inside an architecture of virtual punch cards.

why.headline: WHY_WE_BUILD
why.problem_text: Modern knowledge workers lose hours daily to tasks that don't require human judgment. Manual data processing, queue triage, workflow navigation — time stolen from creativity, relationships, and presence.
why.insight_text: People aren't depleted because they lack tools. They're depleted because their tools demand constant attention. The best infrastructure is the kind you stop noticing.
why.answer_text: Solar Systems AI removes the non-human work entirely — with accountability, auditability, and bounds. Infrastructure that disappears, giving back time for what only humans can do.

guarantees.title: ADEQUATION
guarantees.tagline: Right agent, right task, every time.
guarantees.description: Every task is profiled before execution — not guessed. The system selects the optimal agent based on task characteristics, ensuring consistent quality without manual configuration.

guarantees.title: EFFORT_CONTROL
guarantees.tagline: Every task declares its cost before running.
guarantees.description: No runaway processes, no surprise bills. Every execution has a pre-declared budget for time, resources, and operations. If the budget is exceeded, the task is safely terminated.

guarantees.title: SECURITY
guarantees.tagline: Identity proven at every hop; credentials short-lived and scoped.
guarantees.description: Secrets exist only for the duration of a task and only in the scope where they're needed. No static keys, no permanent access, no credential leakage.

guarantees.title: PRIVILEGE_CONTROL
guarantees.tagline: Fail-closed by default — agents see only what they need.
guarantees.description: Access is earned, not assumed. Every agent operates under strict privilege modes — from fully supervised to autonomous — with boundaries that cannot be overridden from within.

guarantees.title: QUALITY_CONTROL
guarantees.tagline: Every output is evaluated before delivery.
guarantees.description: Nothing reaches you without passing quality gates. Pre-execution, mid-execution, and post-execution checkpoints ensure consistent, reliable results.

guarantees.title: IDEMPOTENCY
guarantees.tagline: Run it twice, get the same result.
guarantees.description: The same operation applied multiple times produces the same outcome. Your system is resilient to retries, restarts, and network failures by design.

about.headline: ABOUT
about.positioning: Solar Systems AI is built on the conviction that intelligent infrastructure should serve human ends — not demand human attention. We build systems that disappear from notice, freeing people for what matters most.
about.approach: Every architectural decision reflects our belief that automation must be bounded, accountable, and in service of human presence. This is not 'AI everywhere' — this is AI precisely where it belongs.
